lines.text: Many learners say: Sorry for late.
Use a full phrase: I'm late.

data.why: Use a full phrase: I'm late.

native.tip: Sorry for late は不自然。Sorry I'm late. と主語と動詞を入れます。
native.caption: “Sorry for late.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「遅れてごめん」をそのまま訳すと不自然に。Sorry のあとは I'm late と文の形にします。 “Sorry I'm late.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“late”。I'm late と文で言おう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say Sorry I'm late. Use a full sentence after sorry.
en.caption: Do you say “Sorry for late.”? 😅 A word-for-word translation sounds odd. After sorry, say a full phrase: I'm late. The natural way is “Sorry I'm late.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
